verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own docs call Isaac Lab an open-source framework (docs-17, docs-6). Isaac Sim has a public GitHub repository (gh-1, gh-6), and its docs describe building your own .whl files from local modifications or branches (docs-65). A community report also says Isaac GR00T N1 was released under Apache 2 (comm-3). Missing for 10: the specific license for Isaac Sim and Isaac ROS is not stated in first-party evidence, the GR00T license claim comes only from a community comment, and nothing confirms that the full platform source (rather than selected components) is open.
